entry: Uptrend on the hourly close and a pullback that holds the slower average.
exit: Close back through the slower average or a predeclared invalidation.
sizing_envelope: At most the mandate single-asset fraction.
invalidation: Hourly close below the slower average.
execution: Spot limit or market on a fresh quote. No same-bar fill.
costs: Conservative taker fee unless a resting limit is assumed maker.
validation: Forward paper versus cash baseline. One change at a time.
